subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw support AI-generated Control UI tool titles as a permanent opt-in configuration and write-scoped Gateway API?
rationale: The PR deliberately reintroduces model egress, token spending, persisted cache state, configuration, and protocol surface after those behaviors were removed from main; code review can validate implementation but cannot authorize that permanent product contract.

options.title: Keep the opt-in feature
options.body: Accept the configuration and API direction after the routing, cache-lifecycle, multi-pane, and live-proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep deterministic rendering only
options.body: Decline the new surface and retain current main's model-free Control UI tool rendering.

recommendation.title: Keep the opt-in feature
recommendation.body: Accept the configuration and API direction after the routing, cache-lifecycle, multi-pane, and live-proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the strongest merged feature history and the canonical opt-in proposal for this exact behavior.
